title: Sturdy
text: Sturdy. I have been dissatisfied with my laundry hamper. I saw this and thought it was promising. It is a nice laundry hamper. There are metal poles or sticks that you insert into a sleeve on the interior of the hamper. Those keep it upright and help with the sturdiness. The lid only attaches by Velcro, so I found it to be more of a hindrance than a selling point. As nice as it is, I found that it wasn't big enough for my needs. It would not hold a week's worth of clothes for my husband and me. Coincidentally, my 24 year old son asked me for a new hamper a day or two before this one arrived. He decided he wants 2 hampers so he can pre-sort his dirty clothes before doing his laundry. This is perfect for him since he's just one person.
